notes.title: Patch Notes - July 17, 2025
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Fixed the issue where dragging a popup warning caused the window to remain on screen after clicking[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where synergy effects didn’t update properly after switching drivers[/p][/*][*][p]Added auto-loot for dropped items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where window wasn’t centered after changing resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed D-pad not working on controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Added multilingual support: Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and more
Thanks for all your feedback and support! Feel free to keep sending suggestions — we’ll keep improving the experience![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: BROTANK – Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes: [olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where setting the volume to 0 would cause problems when minimizing the game window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when switching to the Settings menu from the Store or Pause screen and then going back[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent rotation speed on [b]SpikeArmor[/b], which now correctly scales with attack speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when swapping tank positions[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks again for playing BROTANK! Feel free to share more feedback—we’re constantly improving the game.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes | New Difficulty, New Synergies, Lots of Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]✅ [b]System Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Difficulty 2 is now unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🧨 [b]Equipment Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new synergy between [i]Energy Blades[/i] and [i]Energy-Draining Machine Gun[/i] with [i]Molotov[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][i]Spike Armor[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Now rotates faster based on attack speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added synergy with Molotov.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotation formula updated; visual assets updated as well.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ [b]Other Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Burning status warning added: burning will no longer kill the tank—it will leave it at 1 HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items (skill books, supplies) will no longer get stuck in buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings will no longer overlap when generated.[/p][/*][*][p]Flame and oil tile effects reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu now shows correctly before the result screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a black screen dialogue guide at game start.[/p][/*][*][p]UI guidance now appears only after moving the tank to the right.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed monsters getting stuck when dashing into buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Store now supports the pause menu popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed translation issues in socketing interface in English mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized word wrapping for weapon descriptions in upgrade/shop/warehouse interfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Items you cannot afford, sockets, and refreshes are now marked in red.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved drag-and-drop performance for equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment synergy effect prompts are now more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Installable slots are now always visible.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Fireproof Armor effects disappearing when switching tank positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing English description for Energy-Draining Machine Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss not dying bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where synergy count in store updated but bonus effect info did not.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where replacing tank gear via keyboard didn’t trigger fusion in warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minimap navigation rendering issue.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]📢 [b]Final Note[/b]
We hope you enjoy the new content! If you have any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports, feel free to leave a comment. We're continuously working to improve the experience and bring you a better tank-building roguelike![/p]
